34817-tales-of-the-wonder-club-volume-ii.title: Tales Of The Wonder Club.
34817-tales-of-the-wonder-club-volume-ii.creator: Dryasdust.
34817-tales-of-the-wonder-club-volume-ii.description: A book by Dryasdust.. Well, gentlemen, when I was a youngster, that is to say, a lad of nineteen, I fell deeply in love with my Molly, who, though I say it, was the finest lass in the village and for miles round it. For all the world like my Helen, at her age, bless her dear heart! She was the daughter of a rich miller--his only child.

arxiv-2307-05894.title: On Maximal Functions Associated to Families of Curves in the Plane
arxiv-2307-05894.creator: Joshua Zahl
arxiv-2307-05894.description: Abstract We consider the L p L^{p} mapping properties of maximal averages associated to families of curves, and thickened curves, in the plane. These include the (planar) Kakeya maximal function, the circular maximal functions of Wolff and Bourgain, and their multi-parameter analogues.

arxiv-2311-16338.title: Releasing the CRaQAn (Coreference Resolution in Question-Answering): An open-source dataset and dataset creation methodology using instruction-following models
arxiv-2311-16338.creator: Rob Grzywinski, Joshua D’Arcy, MD, Rob Naidoff, Ashish Shukla, Alex Browne, Ren Gibbons, Brinnae Bent, PhD
arxiv-2311-16338.description: Abstract Instruction-following language models demand robust methodologies for information retrieval to augment instructions for question-answering applications. A primary challenge is the resolution of coreferences in the context of chunking strategies for long documents. The critical barrier to experimentation of handling coreferences is a lack of open source datasets, specifically in question-answering tasks that require coreference resolution.

arxiv-2405-20946.title: Fast characterization of multiplexed single-electron pumps with machine learning
arxiv-2405-20946.creator: N. Schoinas, Y. Rath, S. Norimoto, W. Xie, P. See, J. P. Griffiths, C. Chen, D. A. Ritchie, M. Kataoka, A. Rossi, I. Rungger
arxiv-2405-20946.description: Abstract We present an efficient machine learning based automated framework for the fast tuning of single-electron pump devices into current quantization regimes. It uses a sparse measurement approach based on an iterative active learning algorithm to take targeted measurements in the gate voltage parameter space.

arxiv-2506-14565.title: Fabrication of airbridges with gradient exposure
arxiv-2506-14565.creator: Yuting Sun, Jiayu Ding, Xiaoyu Xia, Xiaohan Wang, Jianwen Xu, Shuqing Song, Dong Lan, Jie Zhao, Yang Yu
arxiv-2506-14565.description: Abstract In superconducting quantum circuits, airbridges are critical for eliminating parasitic slotline modes of coplanar waveguide circuits and reducing crosstalks between direct current magnetic flux biases. Here, we present a technique for fabricating superconducting airbridges. With this technique, a single layer of photoresist is employed, and the gradient exposure process is used to define the profile of airbridges.

arxiv-2509-21470.title: Score-based Idempotent Distillation of Diffusion Models
arxiv-2509-21470.creator: Shehtab Zaman, Chengyan Liu, & Kenneth ChiuSchool of ComputingState University of New York at BinghamtonBinghamton, NY 13902, USA {szaman5,cliu118,kchiu}@binghamton.edu
arxiv-2509-21470.description: Abstract Idempotent generative networks (IGNs) are a new line of generative models based on idempotent mapping to a target manifold. IGNs support both single-and multi-step generation, allowing for a flexible trade-off between computational cost and sample quality. But similar to Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), conventional IGNs require adversarial training and are prone to training instabilities and mode collapse.

arxiv-2601-14068.title: Modular Attractor Acceleration in Infinite-State Games (Full Version)
arxiv-2601-14068.creator: Philippe Heim✉, Rayna Dimitrova
arxiv-2601-14068.description: Abstract Infinite-state games provide a framework for the synthesis of reactive systems with unbounded data domains. Solving such games typically relies on computing symbolic fixpoints, particularly symbolic attractors. However, these computations may not terminate, and while recent acceleration techniques have been proposed to address this issue, they often rely on acceleration arguments of limited expressiveness.

pmc-10624901.title: Multiple parallel origins of parasitic Marine Alveolates
pmc-10624901.creator: Corey C Holt, Elisabeth Hehenberger, Denis V Tikhonenkov, Victoria K L Jacko-Reynolds, Noriko Okamoto, Elizabeth C Cooney, Nicholas A T Irwin, Patrick J Keeling
pmc-10624901.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Microbial eukaryotes are important components of marine ecosystems, and the Marine Alveolates (MALVs) are consistently both abundant and diverse in global environmental sequencing surveys. MALVs are dinoflagellates that are thought to be parasites of other protists and animals, but the lack of data beyond ribosomal RNA gene sequences from all but a few described species means much of their biology and evolution remain unknown.

pmc-10631730.title: Global biogeography of the smallest plankton across ocean depths
pmc-10631730.creator: Pedro C. Junger, Hugo Sarmento, Caterina R. Giner, Mireia Mestre, Marta Sebastián, Xosé Anxelu G. Morán, Javier Arístegui, Susana Agustí, Carlos M. Duarte, Silvia G. Acinas, Ramon Massana, Josep M. Gasol, Ramiro Logares
pmc-10631730.description: Tiny ocean plankton (picoplankton) are fundamental for the functioning of the biosphere, but the ecological mechanisms shaping their biogeography were partially understood. Comprehending whether these microorganisms are structured by niche versus neutral processes is relevant in the context of global change.

pmc-11325553.title: Expanding the Phase Space for Halide-Based Solid Electrolytes: Li–Mg–Zr–Cl Spinels
pmc-11325553.creator: Christopher L Rom, Philip Yox, Abby M Cardoza, Rebecca W Smaha, Maxwell Q Phan, Trevor R Martin, Annalise E Maughan
pmc-11325553.description: Chloride-based solid electrolytes are intriguing materials owing to their high Li+ ionic conductivity and electrochemical compatibility with high-voltage oxide cathodes for all-solid-state lithium batteries. However, the leading examples of these materials are limited to trivalent metals (e.g., Sc, Y, and In), which are expensive and scarce.

pmc-11658132.title: Clinical features of Tibetan adolescent tuberculosis at high altitudes: a retrospective study
pmc-11658132.creator: Min Shen, Wen Luo, Banjiu Luobu, Yirong Chen, Peiyan Zhang, Ruisi Qiu, Xuerong Chen, Weiping Guo, Peifen Chen
pmc-11658132.description: BackgroundAdolescent pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) is considered inadequately recognized and underreported at high altitudes. This study aimed to investigate the clinical features of adolescent pulmonary TB patients at high altitudes in China.MethodA retrospective analysis was performed at Linzhi People’s Hospital. Patients recruited were newly diagnosed with pulmonary TB.

pmc-11712616.title: Generation and validation of anti‐TREM2 agonistic antibodies to enable the advancement of drug targets in the TREM2/DAP12 signaling pathway for the treatment of Alzheimer Disease
pmc-11712616.creator: Mustapha Moussaif, June Javens‐Wolfe, Alan D. Palkowitz, Timothy I. Richardson
pmc-11712616.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundTREM2 signaling has been implicated in Alzheimer’s Disease (AD). TREM2 regulates microglial states and functions such as phagocytosis. The most prominent TREM signaling adapter is DAP12, encoded by TYROBP. Understanding functional changes of this complex, and downstream effectors such as SHIP1, PLCG2 and the Scr family kinases Lyn and Hck, is required to evaluate a broad range of therapeutic hypotheses and drug targets for prioritization and enablement.

pmc-12519263.title: Antifibrotic Efficacy of a Nintedanib–Peptide Conjugate and Diagnostic Potential of a Fluorescent Companion Probe Targeting αVβ6 Integrin in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
pmc-12519263.creator: Kelly Bugatti, Erica Ferrini, Margherita Restori, Costanza Bonfini, Melissa Marchese, Francesca Bianchini, Sara Tomassetti, Andrea Maurizio, Monica Baiula, Lucia Battistini, Enrico Marcantonio, Claudio Curti, Monica Civera, Laura Belvisi, Andrea Sartori, Franco F. Stellari, Franca Zanardi
pmc-12519263.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a fatal fibrotic pathology currently treated with two antifibrotic drugs, nintedanib and pirfenidone; however, more effective and safer cell-specific therapeutic agents are needed to overcome their limited efficacy and tolerability. αvβ6 integrin is a clinically validated fibrosis biomarker, and several αvβ6-targeted small molecules and positron emission tomography (PET) tracers have recently proven their therapeutic and diagnostic potential in IPF. Surprisingly, αvβ6-targeted and fibrosis-related drug conjugates are still lacking.

pmc-12607203.title: Development of a PRISMA extension for systematic reviews of health economic evaluations (PRISMA-EconEval): a project protocol
pmc-12607203.creator: Phuong Bich Tran, Joseph Kwon, Andrew Booth, Anastasios Bastounis, Ewan M Tomeny, Sophie Staniszewska, Richard Grant, Kednapa Thavorn, Dalia Dawoud, Rafael Pinedo-Villanueva, Sally Hopewell, Matthew J Page, Stavros Petrou
pmc-12607203.description: BackgroundSystematic reviews of health economic evaluations are key for evidence-based decisions but lack standardised reporting. This project aims to develop a Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) extension for systematic reviews of health economic evaluations (PRISMA-EconEval).MethodsProject stages include the following: (1) scoping review, (2) Delphi surveys, (3) consensus meeting, (4) piloting, and (5) finalisation and dissemination.

pmc-13619528.title: Analysis of ocular biometrics in cataract patients aged 40 and above in Suzhou, China
pmc-13619528.creator: Yanfeng Zeng, Wei Song, Quan Yuan, Xiaoqin Wang, Yana Ma, Huan Hu
pmc-13619528.description: PurposeThis cross-sectional study investigated the distribution of ocular biometric parameters in cataract patients aged ≥40 years from East China, with a specific focus on age- and sex-related differences and their correlations. Given the paucity of large-sample reference data for this population, we aimed to establish a localized framework to support precise surgical planning in refractive cataract surgery.

pmc-13654130.title: Left ventricular function and volumes from cardiac magnetic resonance and gated [13N]-ammonia positron emission tomography myocardial perfusion imaging in patients with ischemia with no obstructive coronary arteries: a prospective head-to-head comparison using hybrid positron emission tomography/mag
pmc-13654130.creator: Runze Wen, Qiang Xie, Ming Ni, Bo Pan, Xingxing Zhu, Xueer Meng, Dan Li, Xuemei Wang
pmc-13654130.description: BackgroundElectrocardiogram (ECG)-gated 13N-ammonia positron emission tomography (PET) myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI) has been widely validated for the assessment of left ventricular (LV) volumes and function. This study aimed to compare the accuracy of LV volumes and functional parameters derived from 13N-ammonia PET with those obtained by cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), using CMR as the reference standard.
